maya: Heads-up: PR #4321 changes /generate request: 'verbosity' now an enum (nullable) instead of a numeric level. Top example and Rust snippet still show \"verbosity: 1\". Need docs + SDK snippet updates. cc @sam

sam: Where's the Rust snippet? Are Python/Go examples affected?

ivan: Runtime currently coerces ints to enum strings but coercion will be removed next minor. Docs should show canonical strings (Low|Medium|High), a nullable example, and a migration note mapping ints -> strings.

maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321  - generate.md top example + Rust snippet at bottom.

sam: I'll update Rust, add curl/python/go examples using strings, and include nullable omission example. Draft Rust:

```rust
let req = GenerateRequest {
  model: \"rw-1\",
  prompt: \"Summarize...\",
  verbosity: Some(Verbosity::High), // Low|Medium|High
  ..Default::default()
};
let resp = client.generate(req).await?;
```

// Add one-paragraph migration note in CHANGELOG: coercion will be removed; map 0->Low,1->Medium,2->High.

deploy-bot: Dedicated runtime also supports coercion today; schedule removal in next minor. Recommend a 2-week migration window and a small script for bulk mapping.

ivan: Also add small curl sample using string value and a note that default when omitted is Medium. Add deprecation banner on the /generate API ref.

docs-bot: Checklist updated: update examples (Rust/Python/Go/curl), add migration blurb to CHANGELOG, add migration script snippet.

sam: Will push patch and request reviews from @maya and @ivan once CI passes.

maya: Thanks, will merge after tests/docs build and approvals. :thumbsup:
